cache_stability.note: A provider cache reuses a prefix. Appending is only free when the new unit sorts last; a unit that lands mid-order costs the prefix from that point on, and no total order avoids that.

context_bytes.note: Characters, not tokens. The platform is provider-agnostic by contract, and a token count belongs to one tokenizer.

not_measured: provider token counts (input, output, cache creation, cache read)
